release_decision.statement: Approved for release only with Iroh disabled by default. This is not approval for experimental, canary, or supported operation.

rollout.promotion_authority: IPFS Kit release manager and storage on-call

stages.name: disabled
stages.audience: All installations; imports and non-Iroh backends remain functional without a sidecar.
entry_criteria: Offline release and security receipts pass
exit_criteria: Experimental owner and cohort are named
Installable sidecar provenance is reviewed or an explicit source-build procedure is approved
rollback_triggers: Iroh becomes enabled without explicit operator action
Base package import or non-Iroh storage regresses

stages.name: experimental
stages.audience: Explicitly opted-in development and disposable test environments; no production durability claim.
entry_criteria: Test, benchmark, security, and recovery receipts pass
Backup and export are rehearsed on representative data
exit_criteria: At least 14 days of SLO observations
Real-node interoperability and signed artifact receipts pass

stages.name: canary
stages.audience: At most 5% of production backends with an IPFS fallback and named on-call owner.
entry_criteria: Linux and macOS real-node evidence passes
Canary rollback drill preserves blobs and manifests
exit_criteria: At least 30 consecutive days meeting every SLO
Previous-version compatibility and data export are rehearsed
rollback_triggers: P95 latency breach for two windows

stages.name: supported
stages.audience: Production use on the published support matrix with normal support commitments.
entry_criteria: Release manager and storage on-call sign off
Runbooks, compatibility window, migration, deprecation, and portability contracts are current
exit_criteria: Deprecation notice and portability window complete
Every retained namespace is exported or migrated
rollback_triggers: Supported recovery objective cannot be met

procedure: Freeze writes and set iroh.enabled=false for the affected backend.
Capture health, version, manifest-head, operation-ID, and redacted diagnostic receipts.
Stop only the managed sidecar; retain the entire state directory, blob store, manifests, identity backup, and pre-migration snapshot.
Restore the previously attested binary and configuration; restore the snapshot only when the newer format is not downgrade-safe.
Start in read-only isolation, verify every manifest head and referenced blob hash, then export representative files.
Re-enable traffic only after the storage owner signs the verification receipt; otherwise route to the fallback backend and escalate.
verification: Manifest count, namespace IDs, revisions, heads, and canonical manifest hashes match the pre-change inventory.
Every referenced blob is present and its BLAKE3 hash verifies; no GC runs until comparison completes.
Representative portable exports byte-compare with the pre-change export and identity files retain owner-only permissions.

compatibility.policy: Maintain read/export and peer-transfer compatibility with the immediately previous supported bundle for at least 90 days after replacement. Reject unknown RPC protocols before storage access.
compatibility.version_skew_gate: A passing real-node version_skew receipt is required before canary promotion.

migration.policy: Inventory and export first, stop writes, snapshot state, migrate a copy, verify manifests and blobs, then atomically select the new bundle.
migration.downgrade_policy: Never open migrated live data with an older binary unless the exact downgrade was proven on a copy.
migration.failure_action: Disable Iroh, retain both state copies, restore the previous binary and snapshot, and verify before reopening.

deprecation.policy: Announce the affected bundle or capability, last supported date, replacement, export procedure, and support contact. Never delete data when support ends.

requirements: IPFS CIDs and Iroh hashes remain distinct
Uninstall retains state unless an operator separately confirms deletion

support.primary_queue: IPFS Kit issue tracker with the iroh label
support.escalation: Page the storage on-call for integrity, data-loss, credential, or supported-stage SLO incidents; include only redacted receipts.

known_promotion_blockers: The sidecar release is source-pinned and has no installable, attested platform artifacts.
The checked-in real multi-node interoperability evidence has status not_run.
No 14-day experimental or 30-day canary SLO observation window has been completed.
